title: PIM for Active Directory: show, cut or restore the hybrid worker's network reach
purpose: Shows, cuts or restores the hybrid worker's network reach by turning its VNet peerings off and on, without deleting anything.
whenToRun: -State Show to check the Azure VM worker's peerings after the build; -State Disconnected to stop the worker acting at once (its AD jobs then fail visibly); -State Connected to restore. Not used for an Azure Arc worker (its network is yours).

runAs.name: Network Contributor
runAs.scope: the worker VNet and every VNet it is peered with
runAs.why: updates allowVirtualNetworkAccess on both sides of each peering. -State Show needs only Reader.

changes.target: VNet peerings of the worker VNet (both sides)
changes.object: allowVirtualNetworkAccess = false (Disconnected) or true (Connected); the peerings stay
changes.why: an isolation switch that keeps the topology
changes.undo: run it again with the other -State

parameters.name: TenantId
parameters.help: The tenant; the script refuses a subscription in another one.

readsOnly: the peerings of the worker VNet and of each remote VNet
network: management.azure.com (ARM REST) and login.microsoftonline.com -- browser sign-in or an Invardia support session; no Azure CLI, no PowerShell module
whatIf: Prints each peering and the access change it would make; changes nothing. -State Show is read-only by itself.
undo: Run it again with the other -State; nothing is ever deleted.
